description:
Voyager is an innovative space, defense, and national security technology company committed to advancing and delivering transformative, mission-critical solutions. We tackle the most complex challenges to unlock new frontiers for human progress, fortify national security, and protect critical assets to lead in the race for technological and operational superiority from ground to space. 

 Forge the Future: Join Voyager Technologies  

 The future belongs to those who build it. At Voyager Technologies, we’re building technologies that protect lives, expand frontiers and prepare us for what’s next. And we’re doing that with people who are wired to solve, build, adapt and lead. These roles are not for the faint of heart.  

 You’ll help lay the foundation for humanity's future. Join a culture where innovation thrives, curiosity is rewarded, and impact is real. We’re a company of doers, thinkers and builders, united by purpose and grounded in reality. 

 If you want to put your skills to work where the stakes are real and the mission is bigger than any one person,  forge the future with Voyager.  

 The Company is currently seeking Machine Learning Engineers who can develop cutting edge Deep Learning technologies applied to pressing problems in the domain of Computer Vision, Synthetic Aperture Radar (SAR), and Geospatial Exploitation. You will have considerable responsibility, and your role will have direct impact on relevant issues facing the United States government customers.

 This posting stays open continuously. We hire machine learning engineers at several levels, from early career to senior staff, and review applications on a rolling basis. Your level and title are determined during the hiring process, based on your experience and the scope of your past work. See Levels We Hire For below.

 This position is based in El Segundo, CA. If your experience aligns with our required qualifications and you are inspired by our mission, we’d like to connect. If you don’t see the right role right now, Join Our Talent Community and stay connected as we continue to build what’s next.

 In this role, the essential functions are:   

 We hire at five levels; each row shows the typical experience and scope.

 
 
 
 
 Title

 
 
 Typical experience

 
 
 Scope

 
 
 
 
 
 
 Machine Learning Engineer I

 
 
 0–2 years

 
 
 Implements models and ML pipelines under guidance. Usually holds a BS or MS and may have internship or research experience.

 
 
 
 
 Machine Learning Engineer II

 
 
 2–5 years

 
 
 Independently develops and deploys ML solutions. Can take an ML problem from requirements through implementation, including production deployment, model monitoring, feature engineering and experimentation.

 
 
 
 
 Senior Machine Learning Engineer

 
 
 5–8 years

 
 
 Owns complex ML systems and technical projects. Makes architecture decisions, mentors junior engineers, and works closely with product, data and platform teams.

 
 
 
 
 Staff Machine Learning Engineer

 
 
 8–12+ years

 
 
 Provides technical leadership across teams and systems, beyond simply owning larger individual projects. Defines architecture and technical direction across multiple teams and influences engineering standards and ML strategy.

 
 
 
 
 Senior Staff Machine Learning Engineer

 
 
 12–15+ years

 
 
 Sets organization-wide technical strategy and architecture. Responsible for very large technical problems and/or company-wide ML architecture and strategy.

 
 
 
 
  

 At every level, you will:

 
 Research, conceive, design, prototype and/or implement advanced Deep Neural Network Architectures as well as other relevant Machine Learning models.

 Apply deep learning algorithms to train neural networks for object detection and classification.

 Develop domain-aware pre-processing algorithms, and other methods to increase model generalization.

 Apply signal pre-processing techniques on SAR data.

 Create physics simulations of various phenomenologies and develop methods to account for bias between simulated and real-world data.

 Develop appropriate objective functions and sound performance assessment plans.

 Present work at meetings and conferences.

 Develop and deliver production-quality code (mainly Python).

 
 As you move up in level, responsibilities build on those above:

 
 Machine Learning Engineer II and above: independently take machine learning problems from requirements through implementation, including production deployment, model monitoring, feature engineering and experimentation.

 Senior Machine Learning Engineer and above: own complex machine learning systems and technical projects, make architecture decisions, mentor junior engineers, and work closely with product, data and platform teams.

 Staff Machine Learning Engineer and above: provide technical leadership across teams and systems, define architecture and technical direction across multiple teams, and influence engineering standards and ML strategy.

 Senior Staff Machine Learning Engineer: set organization-wide technical strategy and architecture, and own very large technical problems and/or company-wide ML architecture and strategy.

 
  

 If your experience aligns with our basic qualifications and you are inspired by our mission, we’d like to connect. If you don’t see the right role right now,  Join Our Talent Community and stay connected as we continue to build what’s next.  

 
 
 Qualifications build by level: each level includes everything from the level before it, plus the items listed. Years shown are years of applicable experience.

 Machine Learning Engineer I (0–2 years) 

 
 Bachelor’s degree in engineering or a related field.

 
 Machine Learning Engineer II (2–5 years): all Machine Learning Engineer I qualifications, plus: 

 
 Experience independently taking an ML problem from requirements through implementation.

 Experience with production deployment, model monitoring, feature engineering and experimentation.

 
 Senior Machine Learning Engineer (5–8 years): all Machine Learning Engineer II qualifications, plus: 

 
 A record of owning complex ML systems and technical projects.

 Experience making architecture decisions and mentoring junior engineers.

 Experience partnering with product, data and platform teams.

 
 Staff Machine Learning Engineer (8–12+ years): all Senior Machine Learning Engineer qualifications, plus: 

 
 A record of technical leadership across teams and systems, beyond owning larger individual projects.

 Experience defining architecture and technical direction across multiple teams.

 Experience influencing engineering standards and ML strategy.

 
 Senior Staff Machine Learning Engineer (12–15+ years): all Staff Machine Learning Engineer qualifications, plus: 

 
 A record of setting organization-wide technical strategy and architecture.

 Experience owning very large technical problems and/or company-wide ML architecture and strategy.

 Experience developing or guiding advanced machine learning, signal-processing and exploitation algorithms, and leading technical efforts across organizational and disciplinary boundaries.

 Ability to evaluate unfamiliar sensors and datasets using first-principles reasoning.

 Ability to communicate complex technical concepts to expert and non-expert audiences, mentor senior technical staff, and operate effectively with limited direction.

 


 
 Preferred Qualifications: 

 These apply across all levels.

 
 Master’s degree or PhD.

 Strong background in Machine Learning (preferably Deep Neural Networks).

 Need to be flexible in a small business environment.

 Familiarity with radar sensing phenomenology.

 Open Source frameworks is a huge plus.

 Ability to program in multiple languages (Python, Matlab, C/C++).

 Experience connecting physics-based signal processing with machine learning, computer vision, or automated exploitation.

 Expertise in areas such as target detection and recognition, geolocation, or multimodal fusion.

 
  

 Travel, Physical and/or Government Mandated Requirements: 

 
 Ability to obtain and maintain a US Government Security Clearance 

 
 The good faith base salary range   for this role is $120,000 - $280,000 at the time of this posting. Where you fall within the range depends on your experience, skills, and location. This range reflects base salary only and does not include benefits or bonus/incentive. This range may be adjusted in the future.

  

 Voyager offers a highly competitive total compensation package designed to support the well-being, growth, and success of our employees. Employees benefit from a flexible and comprehensive rewards program that supports both professional and personal well-being.  

 
 Flexible Time Off (FTO), empowering employees to take the time they need to recharge and maintain a healthy work-life balance

 Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage for employees and their families, with a significant portion of premiums covered by the company and many benefits paid at 100% for employees

 Flexible, affordable gym memberships with 12,700+ options nationwide, including 24 Hour Fitness, EoS Fitness, Crunch Fitness, Anytime Fitness, Blink Fitness, Chuze Fitness, and more! No long-term contracts and FREE on-demand workout videos before you enroll

 401(k) retirement plan with a 50% company match on contributions up to 8%, supporting long-term financial security

 Company wellness programs that support physical and mental well-being

 Additional voluntary benefits and employee support resources

 The opportunity to work alongside a highly talented team in an innovative, mission-driven environment

 
 Voyager is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, national or ethnic origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, disability, protected veteran status, or other characteristics protected by law.  

 To conform to U.S. Government export regulations, including the International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR) (22 CFR Parts 120–130) and the Export Administration Regulations (EAR) (15 CFR Parts 730–774), applicants for this position must be a U.S. Person: a US Citizen, a lawful permanent resident of the U.S., or a protected individual as defined by 8 U.S.C. § 1324b(a)(3). Applicants must be eligible to obtain any required export authorizations from the U.S. Department of State or the U.S. Department of Commerce.   

 Minority/Female/Disabled/Veteran 

 The statements contained in this job description are intended to describe the general content and requirements for performance of this job. It is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all job duties, responsibilities, and requirements. This job description is not an employment agreement or contract. Management has the exclusive right to alter the scope of work within the framework of this job description at any time without prior notice.
